meta.name: who-decides
meta.description: Map stakeholders, decision rights, influence and blockers from supplied evidence. Use when ownership is unclear or the stakeholder landscape changes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把零散线索整理成一张谁拍板、谁影响、谁挡路的关系图
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果项目里没人说得清谁最终拍板、谁只是影响者。
copy.tagline_en: Turn scattered clues into a clear map of who decides, who influences, and who blocks
copy.fit_line_en: For you if nobody can say who really makes the call and who only influences.

howto.what: 它会根据你提供的材料,梳理出干系人、各自的决策权、影响力和阻碍者,并把实施、验证、部署和验收区分开。
howto.when: 当所有权(谁负责)不清晰,或干系人格局发生变化时使用;若由 @fde 调用,则复用其当前已脱敏的数据包与范围,不重跑已答的步骤。

say.text: 根据这份材料,列出干系人、决策权和可能的阻碍者
say.note: 会输出角色与权限的映射

say.text: 这个项目现在没人真正拍板,帮我理清谁有决定权
干系人最近换了一批,重新梳理影响力和决策权

howto.what_en: From the material you supply, it maps stakeholders, decision rights, influence and blockers, and separates implementation, verification, deployment and acceptance.
howto.when_en: Use when ownership is unclear or the stakeholder landscape changes. Called by @fde, it reuses that run's sanitized packet and scope instead of restarting.

say_en.text: From this material, list the stakeholders, decision rights and likely blockers
Nobody really signs off on this project; help me map who holds decision rights
The stakeholders just changed; re-map influence and decision rights
say_en.note: Redraws the map for the new lineup
